fork_chain.description: Chained forks apply in order; keys are never sorted or merged.

label.description: A name key is a string literal; its decoded UTF-8 bytes are hashed exactly.

label_hash.description: The hash of a name key's bytes.

index_type.description: The type of an index key.

text_fork.description: base.fork(label), with hash32 the VM's hash instruction, on u32 bits.

index_fork.description: base.fork(index), on the two's-complement bits of index.

conversion.description: Reads a seed's 32 bits as an i32.

implicit_conversion.description: A seed never converts implicitly; int(s) is required for arithmetic, bits or f32.

seed_parameters.description: Builtins with a parameter of role seed, which take an i32 or a seed.

other_seed_arguments.description: Other seed arguments that take an i32 or a seed: choose's first argument and a part call's seed.

locals.description: A local takes the type seed from its first assignment.

choices.description: Choices of pick and choose cannot hold seeds.

models.description: Models (spec models v1.2): what an asset with render { } adds to the language and what it leaves out. Required from schema 8. The contract is a preview: while `status` says so, any field here may change with a release.

status.description: Stability of everything under `models`: a preview is not frozen.

contract.description: The specification of the model format and runtime, by its file name without the extension.

entry.description: The name of the entry block of a model asset.

entry_syntax.description: How the entry block is written; it has no parameters and returns nothing.

entry_keyword.description: `render` is an entry only when a block follows it inside an asset; elsewhere it is an ordinary name.

asset_entries.description: An asset has `draw { }` or `render { }`, never both and never neither.

file_extension.description: The extension ipc gives the compiled file of a model asset.

file_magic.description: The first four bytes of a compiled model; a 2D runtime rejects the file there.

page_opcode.description: The opcode value that carries every model operation; its aux byte selects one.

section_ids.description: The sections only a model file has.

model.description: The nominal size and the units per metre.

skins.description: The embedded 2D programs the model generates as textures.

outputs.description: The 3D output slots (M3); only in a model that declares outputs.

parts.description: The 3D parts (M3); only in a model that has parts.

size_syntax.description: The size declaration of a model asset: three positive integers.

size_meaning.description: The size is a declared box in model units, standing on the ground and centred on the vertical axis; geometry is never clipped to it.

scale_syntax.description: The optional declaration of how many model units make a metre: a positive number literal.

scale_keyword.description: `scale` is a declaration only before a number inside an asset; elsewhere it is an ordinary name.

default_scale.description: Units per metre without a `scale` declaration: a unit is a centimetre.

axes.description: The coordinate system of a model.

ground.description: A model stands on the plane y = 0.

front.description: The side of a model that faces the viewer.

winding.description: The vertex order of every triangle.

angle_unit.description: The unit of the angles of `place`.

geometry_kernel.description: How vertex data is computed, which makes it the same on every platform.

inputs.description: Inputs are visible in the entry block alone, as in a draw asset.

origin.description: Whether a model asset may declare `origin`.

outputs.description: 3D outputs of a model asset (M3): points and boxes in space a host reads beside the mesh.

kinds.description: The output kinds: what a write assigns and what the host receives.

name.description: The name.

value_types.description: The types of the two values of a box.

at.description: Where the first value of a box lies.

size.description: What the second value of a box is.

declaration.description: How an output is declared; `list` makes every write append.

lists.description: Whether both kinds can be lists.

singular.description: A later write of a singular output replaces the earlier value.

list.description: A list output keeps every value written, in program order.

unwritten.description: A singular output never written has no value in the result.

placement.description: A value written inside place blocks goes through their maps, as a vertex built there does.

point_in_deforming_blocks.description: A point written inside bend, twist or taper moves with the vertices.

box_in_deforming_blocks.description: A box written lexically inside bend, twist or taper is a compile error, and a trap when a helper writes it.

shear.description: A box written inside a turn that is not a multiple of 90 degrees, itself inside a place with an unequal scale, traps.

other_blocks.description: smooth, refine and displace leave outputs where they are.

host.description: The host receives the outputs of the model itself, never those of a part.

two_d_outputs.description: Declaring a 2D output kind in a render asset is a compile error.

ops.description: The model operations that write each kind.

point3d.description: The operation that writes a point.

box3d.description: The operation that writes a box.

list_point3d.description: The operation that appends a point.

list_box3d.description: The operation that appends a box.

maximum_slots.description: The output slots of a file, those of parts included.

layers.description: Whether a model asset may capture layers.

clips.description: Whether a model asset may open clip blocks.

model_parts.description: 3D parts (M3): a render asset building an imported render asset where it calls it.

syntax.description: How a part is called: a statement.

statement.description: The call is a statement and has no value.

result.description: The result type of the call.

parameters.description: The parameters: the seed, then each input of the part by name; `$uniform` stands for one input.

name.description: The name.

positional.description: The slot accepts a positional argument.

role.description: Present on the seed slot, which takes an i32 or a seed.

default.description: An omitted input keeps the default of its declaration.

evaluation_order.description: The order the arguments are evaluated in.

placement.description: The part is built in the scope the call stands in.

placement_arguments.description: Whether the call takes placement arguments; place blocks place a part.

stream.description: The part draws from its own stream, started from the seed.

skins.description: The part generates its own skins; equal textures are shared.

scale.description: The part and the model must declare the same units per metre.

size.description: The declared size of a part is informative.

outputs_read.description: How a parent reads an output of a part.

readable_outputs.description: Which outputs a parent can read.

read_where.description: Where a read is valid: in the block that called the part, after the call; elsewhere it traps.

read_value.description: The value is in the coordinates of that block.

nesting.description: A part can import parts of its own.

render_op.description: The model operation of the call.

read_op.description: The model operation of a read.

maximum_parts.description: The part instances of a file.

fuel.description: What a call costs before the part runs: its instruction and its reserve.

optimizer.description: Whether ipc optimizes a model program; `--no-opt` then changes nothing.

types.description: The two value types only a model asset has.

items.description: One type of a model asset.

name.description: The type name, as written after `:` or `->` and before a typed local or constant.

descriptor_code.description: The type descriptor code in a model file.

literal_elements.description: Integer elements of the literal become f32.

components.description: The member names that read one component.

component_ops.description: The model operation of each member read, in the order of `components`.

assignable_components.description: Whether a component can be assigned; a whole new value is assigned instead.

operators.description: The operators of the type and their model operations, or false for a type that takes none.

scalar_operand.description: Where a number may stand beside a vector.

random_range.description: How `a to b` draws between two vectors: one stream draw picks a position and the result lies on the segment.

random_range_op.description: The model operation that mixes the two ends.

arithmetic.description: The numeric rules of the operators.

typed_zero.description: The value of a local whose first assignment never ran.

storage.description: Where a value of the type may be kept.

collections.description: Elements of lists, samplers and steppers.

representation.description: What the program carries for a skin.

wire_type.description: Whether the format or a host has a type for it.

unassigned.description: What happens when a skin that was never assigned reaches a primitive or a modifier.

modifiers.description: A `skin.*` builtin never changes the skin it is given.

lists.description: The lists of the type (M3): literals, indexing and list.len.

index.description: Whether an element is read by index.

length.description: The builtin that counts the elements.

constants.description: Whether an asset constant may be a list of the type.

sort.description: Whether the list can be sorted.

distinct.description: Whether repeated elements can be dropped.

maximum_elements.description: The most elements of a list.

type_keywords.description: `vec3` and `skin` name types only where a type is expected.

types_in_draw_assets.description: What a draw asset gets for declaring one of these types.

compound_of_three.description: What `{a, b, c}` is in each kind of asset.

draw.description: In a draw asset, where it is the value of a circle output.

builtins.description: The builtins only a model asset has, with the overloads of the shared signature registry.

extended_builtins.description: Builtins of the 2D table that gain overloads in a model asset: the added overloads alone.

unavailable_builtins.description: Builtins of the 2D table a model asset cannot call, because they need a canvas, a surface or 2D geometry.

builtin_effects.description: How to read `effects.writes_canvas` on a signature of a model asset.

anchor.description: Where the `at` of a primitive lies on the solid.

keyword.description: `place` opens a block only as a call followed by one; a helper may have the name.

minimum_arguments.description: The fewest arguments a block takes.

duplicate_arguments.description: Whether an argument may be given twice.

arguments.description: The arguments in their evaluation order.

name.description: The argument name.

types.description: The value types it accepts; an integer becomes f32.

evaluation_order.description: The order in which argument values are evaluated.

written_order_changes_evaluation.description: Whether the written order of the arguments matters.

composition.description: The order in which one block applies its arguments to what it contains.

right_angles.description: Turns by multiples of 90 degrees use no trigonometry.

nesting.description: How a block inside another block is positioned.

mirror.description: What mirroring does to the triangles.

texture_mapping.description: Texture coordinates come from the sizes written inside the block, so a scaled block shows its textures scaled with it.

maximum_open_scopes.description: How many blocks may be open at once.

scope_cleanup.description: The ways of leaving a block that close it.

begin_op.description: The model operation that opens the block.

fuel.description: The fuel of opening a block.

effects.description: Intrinsic effects of opening a block.

skin_call.description: The call that generates an imported draw asset as a texture.

syntax.description: How the call is written; it is an expression.

parameters.description: The binder slots; `$uniform` stands for each input of the imported asset.

name.description: The slot name.

positional.description: The slot accepts a positional argument.

role.description: Present on the seed slot, which takes an i32 or a seed.

type.description: The value type of the size slot.

default.description: An omitted input keeps the default of its declaration.

evaluation_order.description: The order in which the arguments are evaluated.

size.description: How `size` selects the pixel size of the texture.

maximum_side.description: The largest width or height of a texture.

placement_arguments.description: Whether the call takes `at`, `rot` or mirrors, as a part call does.

generation.description: How the texture is made: its pixels are the ones a host gets from the same program.

fuel.description: Whose fuel budget the texture spends.

reserved_fuel.description: The fuel the model program pays for one call beyond its instruction.

sharing.description: When two calls give one texture.

auxiliary_images.description: What happens to the images the program publishes beside its picture, such as a normal map.

render_asset_target.description: Whether a model asset can be the target.

draw_op.description: The model operation of the call.

skin_defaults.description: The skin a call returns, before any modifier.

mapping.description: How the texture lies on a face.

shift.description: The offset of the texture in texels.

alpha.description: How the alpha of the texture is used.

cutoff.description: The alpha below which a cutout pixel is not drawn.

two_sided.description: Whether both sides of a face are drawn.

crisp.description: Whether texels stay sharp squares instead of being filtered.

with_map.description: Where the texture publishes a roughness, metallic or emission map, that number starts here instead: it multiplies the map.

mapping.description: How a face gets its texture coordinates.

repeat.description: The repeating mapping: the texture tiles at a fixed number of texels to a unit.

fit.description: The fitting mapping, selected by skin.fit.

uv_origin.description: The corner of the image that has the coordinates (0, 0).

unit.description: The size of a texel on a model with the default skin.

region.description: The window mapping of skin.region: the window once across each face; a face coordinate beyond its face is clamped to the face.

region_units.description: The units of a window: those of the size the skin program declares.

region_bleed.description: Filtering still reads texels next to a window: leave a gutter around each field or use skin.crisp.

alpha_modes.description: How a skin uses the alpha of its texture: ignored, tested against the cutoff (skin.cutout) or blended over what is behind (skin.blend).

material_maps.description: Material maps on skins (material maps v1.2).

source.description: A texture carries every image its program publishes: the normal map and the material maps.

numbers.description: The roughness, metallic and emission numbers of a skin multiply the map of their kind.

without_a_map.description: Without a map of its kind a number stands alone.

emission_without_a_map.description: Without an emission map, emission multiplies the colour of the texture, as before maps.

occlusion_number.description: Whether a skin has a number for ambient occlusion; the map is used as it is.

imported_constants.description: A render asset reads the constants of a draw asset it imports: one layout shared by the texture and the shape.

declarations.description: What can be read: the const declarations of the imported asset.

evaluation.description: The value is folded where it is read; nothing runs in the imported asset.

shadowed_by.description: A local or a parameter named like the alias is read instead.

in_own_constants.description: Whether the asset's own const declarations may read them.

draw_assets.description: Whether a draw asset may read its imports' constants.

limits.description: The limits of one generation and of one file.

texture_side.description: Width or height of one texture.

skin_records.description: Skins a generation makes, modifiers included.

skin_programs.description: Imported assets one model can use as skins.

path_points.description: Points of the path of a sweep.

vertex.description: What a primitive reserves for each vertex it emits.

triangle.description: What a primitive reserves for each triangle it emits.

extrude_outline.description: What an extrude reserves for the checks and the triangulation of its outline, which grow with the square of its points.

place_reserve.description: What place.begin reserves beyond its instruction, for composing the scope.

skin_draw_reserve.description: What a skin call reserves beyond its instruction, also when it reuses a texture.

sweep_profile.description: What a sweep reserves for the checks and triangulation of its profile.

block_reserve.description: What a shaping block reserves when it opens.

smooth_vertex.description: What smooth pays for each vertex.

deform_vertex.description: What bend, twist and taper pay for each vertex.

displace_vertex.description: What displace pays for each vertex.

displace_triangle.description: What displace pays for each triangle.

sweep_path_point.description: What a sweep reserves for each point of its path.

pass_vertex.description: What a closing block or part pays for each vertex it hands on.

pass_triangle.description: What a closing block or part pays for each triangle it hands on.

refine_vertex.description: What refine pays for each vertex it adds.

refine_triangle.description: What refine pays for each triangle it adds.

point3d_output.description: What a point3d output write reserves beyond its instruction.

box3d_output.description: What a box3d output write reserves beyond its instruction.

arena_bytes.description: What a generation charges to its 64 MiB arena.

shaping_blocks.description: Shaping blocks (M3): blocks that collect what their body builds and process it when they close.

syntax.description: How a shaping block is written.

keyword.description: The names are contextual: a block follows the call.

blocks.description: Each block, its parameters, their range and what it does.

name.description: The name.
The name.

begin_op.description: The model operation that opens the block.

frame.description: The space the block processes in: its own, the identity where it opens.

precision.description: Vertices in a block stay binary64 until the block closes.

close.description: At its end the block processes its buffer and hands it to the enclosing scope as one primitive.

axis.description: bend, twist and taper act along Y over the extent of the vertices of the block.

neutral.description: An argument that changes nothing leaves the vertices as they are.

deformed_normals.description: Normals under bend, twist and taper follow the cofactors of the Jacobian.

displaced_normals.description: Normals after displace come from the moved triangles.

weld.description: smooth and displace treat vertices of equal positions as one point.

maximum_open_scopes.description: Scopes open at once, place blocks included.

effects.description: The effects of opening a block.

source_rules.description: Source, binary storage and expression type mappings. Accepted source value categories and conversions.

intrinsic_scope.description: Reported effects exclude argument evaluation and resource failure.

argument_effects.description: Argument effects execute in the caller stream before the operation.

items.description: Limits rejected by the bytecode validator before execution.

validation_limits.description: Limits rejected by the bytecode validator before execution.

allocation_failure.description: Execution or output allocation may fail independently of opcode checks.

part_output_read.description: Reading a singular exported child output.

singular.description: Each scalar write replaces the previous value.

list.description: Each list write appends an element.

effect_rules.description: Resource limits and operation summaries beyond builtin signatures.

evaluation_order.description: Exact parameter permutation; overrides evaluate in caller context.

call_rules.description: Call metadata shared with the compiler binder.

builtins.description: Shared registry exports; order is stable but not an identity key.
